sections.title: Explanation
sections.content: *Miért* means “why”. It goes first and the verb follows: *Miért vársz?* means “Why are you waiting?” The answer starts with *mert*, “because”, and then a whole sentence: *Mert Anna kérdez.*

sections.title: Because: mert
sections.content: *Mert* always starts a clause with its own verb. Inside one sentence, put a comma before it: *Olvasok, mert tanulok.* means “I read because I study.”

items.english: Why do you read? – Because I study.
Why are you walking? – Because Károly is cooking.
Anna waits because Meg is writing.

sections.content: *Miért* and *mert* look alike but do different jobs: *miért* asks, *mert* answers.
